Read Me.Description: Information in this spreads: About the use of Code: Code (i.e., unique numeric code assigned by NCI EVS, in C<<number>> format) is used so that information presented is agnostic to different versions of CDISC Controlled Terminology publications, where Code is immutable in principal and other information such as Submission Value may vary. Users will have the flexibility to pair the Code information with any given publication of their choice.

Statement on copyright permission: A QRS Supplement to the SDTMIG may be for an instrument in the a public domain or for a copyrighted instrument for which the copyright holder has given CDISC permission to develop a supplement. All QRS Supplements to the SDTMIG are created in compliance with CDISC operating procedure COP-001. For copyrighted instruments, note the following:

Granting CDISC the right to create supplements to represent an instrument in CDISC QRS domains is not a license for CDISC standards users to use the instrument without complying with the copyright holders licensing requirements.

No part of a copyrighted instrument or accompanying guidelines may be reproduced, distributed, or transmitted in any form, or by any means, including photocopying, recording, or other electronic or mechanical methods without the permission of the copyright holder and payment of applicable fees.

Warranties, Limitations of Liability, Disclaimers, Copyright Status, and Relationship to the CDISC SDTMIG: Consult the specifics in each QRS Supplement publication, downloadable from the CDISC QRS standards page.
